decisions.decision_rule: Deduct only canonical asset facts whose official disclosure proves non-operating purpose and whose related income is removed from NOPAT; never deduct all cash or create a balance-sheet plug.
classification_rules: restricted cash is never treated as freely deductible cash
operating cash is not deducted by subjective judgment
a financial asset is deductible only when official disclosure proves its non-operating purpose
associate and joint-venture deductions must match removal of their investment income from NOPAT
an unproven asset class defaults to retained in invested capital with an evidence limitation
limitations: A resolved rule does not make the derived amount ready when supporting facts are missing.
